newsitem.title: USA: Samsung wins Sprint PCS contract.
newsitem.headline: Samsung wins Sprint PCS contract.

text.p: Sprint Corp said it awarded a three-year contract worth more than $600 million to Samsung Electronics Co for delivery of wireless telecommunications handsets.
The contract involves so-called code division multiple access (CDMA) handsets to be used as part of the personal communications service (PCS) network that Sprint is constructing in the United States.
Sprint said initial deliveries are scheduled for April.

"We believe this contract will serve as a springboard for Samsung's future marketing efforts of CDMA products in the U.S. and around the world," Samsung Executive Vice President Y.R. Song said in a statement.
